persona: Training executive in a BPO moving into a broader L&D specialist role
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Training Executive, Sahyadri Customer Services Pvt Ltd, Pune (2021 - present)
- Conducted training needs analysis with 12 process managers each quarter and built the annual training calendar.
- Designed product and soft-skills modules and converted 15 classroom sessions into e-learning module development projects in Articulate Rise.
- Delivered classroom training to batches of 25 new hires and ran virtual instructor-led training for night-shift agents.
- Ran the two-week induction programme for about 600 new joiners a year.
- Enrolled learners, assigned courses and pulled monthly completion reports from the Moodle LMS.
- Partnered with HR business partners and operations heads to agree quarterly learning priorities.
- Maintained training attendance and MIS in Excel for the leadership review.

Training Coordinator, Deccan Retail Services, Pune (2019 - 2021)
- Scheduled trainers and venues and collected post-session feedback forms.

SKILLS
Training effectiveness, Kirkpatrick model, MS Excel, Moodle

EDUCATION
MBA (HR), Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2019
